Class CrdbMetrics

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.metrics.CrdbMetrics
public final class CrdbMetrics extends Object
Small facade tying a MetricsRecorder to the core observability bus.

Typical use: 

var metrics = CrdbMetrics.inMemory().register();
String out = metrics.timeTransaction(() -> template.execute(SERIALIZABLE, true, conn -> ...));
MetricsSnapshot snap = ((InMemoryMetricsRecorder) metrics.recorder()).snapshot();

register() attaches a CrdbMetricsListener so retries and circuit-opens are counted automatically. timeTransaction(Callable) additionally records transaction count, success/failure, and duration.

    • timeTransaction

      public <T> T timeTransaction(Callable<T> work)
      Time work as a single transaction, recording its duration and success/failure. Retries occurring inside work are counted independently via the observe bus (see register()); the retry count passed to MetricsRecorder.recordTransaction(Duration, int, boolean) here is 0 because this helper cannot observe the inner attempt count.
      Returns:
      the value produced by work
